prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your exact location in Houston, the type/age of your system, how quickly you need service, and whether you want a cheap fast repair or a company that guarantees work and offers maintenance plans. That said, here’s a quick, practical way to get the best contractor plus a few reputable names to start with.

If you want me to pull up recent ratings for your area, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood. Otherwise, consider these well-known Houston options people commonly recommend:
- John Moore Services — long-standing local company, 24/7 service, broad HVAC/plumbing/electrical offerings.  
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric — family-owned, local reputation for customer service.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (local Houston branches) — national brand with local crews and emergency availability.  
- Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning — national franchise with warranty programs and maintenance plans.  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchise) — often used for prompt service calls and emergency repair.

How to pick the right company
- Verify credentials: EPA 608 certification (required for refrigerant work), proof of insurance, and local business registration.  
- Look for NATE-certified technicians (industry-recognized competency).  
- Check recent Google/Yelp reviews and BBB rating (read recent reviews for response to problems).  
- Ask about warranties: parts and labor, and whether they honor manufacturer warranties.  
- Get a written estimate that lists parts, labor, diagnostic fees, and any permit costs. Ask whether they charge a diagnostic/trouble-shooting fee and whether it’s applied to the repair.  
- Ask about emergency/after-hours fees and typical arrival window.  
- Compare 2–3 written estimates before major repairs or replacement.  
- Prefer companies that pull permits and provide itemized invoices.

If you tell me your ZIP code, the brand/model of your AC, and whether it’s an emergency, I can pull up the top-rated local companies and recent reviews so you can pick the best contractor for your situation.
